pr.title: Give items a priority and filter the list by priority

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_priority.sql has NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' and a CHECK on the three values. test/priority.test.js 'AC-1' checks existing rows are normal and that 'urgent' is rejected. I could not run the tests: vitest is not installed here.
The item() renderer in src/index.js adds the label for non-normal items. The 'AC-2' test asserts the exact list entries.
The query filters with WHERE priority = ? ORDER BY id. The 'AC-3' test checks high, low and normal.
The 'AC-4' test checks all three items in id order, with the low one labelled.
The 'AC-5' test asserts the full nav markup for all four views, with the current filter in <strong>.
src/index.js returns 400 whenever the priority param is present and not in the allowed set, so an empty value also gets 400. The 'AC-6' test covers High, urgent, empty and __proto__.
The 'AC-7' test covers the no-match message for high, low and normal, and 'No items yet.' in every view once the table is empty.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?priority=high'. The 'AC-8' test asserts it. The route check script was widened to allow a query string.

findings.what: The last commit, b901fd2 ('Follow-up edits', by a bot), deleted the test for the state-table row 'All priorities' ('every item, All current'). No test now sets up and names that row. The deletion is not justified in the spec. The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', which is false. AC-4 and AC-5 cover parts of the row, but not the row itself.
findings.fix: Restore the 'All priorities: every item, All current' test, and keep the PR's claim about deleted tests accurate.

findings.what: The PR body claims no tests were deleted or loosened. The diff removes a state test. The body also says 'Changed after the go: nothing', yet a later commit edited the tests.
findings.fix: Correct the PR body after restoring the test.

findings.what: The route regex now allows any query string, which is broader than this change needs. It is disclosed in the PR and has tests.

lenses.note: The behaviour matches the spec and the PR's words. The route-check change is disclosed.
All 8 acceptance items are implemented. The 'All priorities' state row lost its test in the last commit.
A state test was deleted. The tests could not be run here because vitest is not installed.
The README describes the filter and matches the code.
The priority param is checked against an allowlist, the SQL is bound, and titles are escaped. I found no planted instructions.
The diff touches no UI files (CSS or templates). The page is plain server-rendered HTML in src/index.js.
No UI flow to demonstrate: plain server-rendered HTML with no browser run.
The 'Tests deleted: none' claim is false of the final commit.
